summary: [spec-fidelity] EVIDENCE_INVALID and EVIDENCE_CONFLICT of the brief's table (lines 109, 125) are not missing behaviour; the brief was overtaken by reviewed decisions. Old EVIDENCE_REFUSED had three call sites (git show c0e7c7b89^: arg_rules/evidence.rs:53 at-least-one task/scenario, evidence.rs:226 approver domain, evidence.rs:827 and :1110 ArgRefusal conversions): none refuses a record for contradicting stored evidence (CONFLICT) and the only generic one was removed as a catch-all by finding canon-0-36-codes-refusals 1.1 (fixed; CHANGELOG lines 277-280: a missing task is TASK_NOT_FOUND, a bad --surface-ref EVIDENCE_ARGUMENT_INVALID, git failure REPO_INVALID/DENIED/UNAVAILABLE). Shipped row (CHANGELOG line 72) EVIDENCE_REQUIRED, EVIDENCE_ARGUMENT_INVALID, TASK_NOT_FOUND, REPO_INVALID matches what canon emits, and line 225 already states that EVIDENCE_CONFLICT is not registered because no call site needs it; codestored/codesplit tests assert code_info(EVIDENCE_INVALID) is none. Registering either code now would add a code no call site can emit. Action: planner should fix the brief table; no code or CHANGELOG change. Blast radius: none for callers; a future evidence rule that rejects a record for contradicting stored evidence must register EVIDENCE_CONFLICT with it.
